Exclusive Q&A with Queen Ma Helen Abdurajak: A Journey to Divine Governance
In the heart of Southeast Asia, beneath the intricate layers of history and tradition, lies an empire—an ancient and sacred realm known as the Maharlika Kingdom of God Lupah Sug Empire . After centuries of conquest, colonization, and societal shifts, the royal family that once ruled this land is now poised to restore its divine sovereignty and empower the nation with a new era of enlightened governance. Queen Ma Helen Abdurajak, the consort of King Mamay Abdurajak—the grandson of Malaysia and the King of Southeast Asia—has embraced this divine mission with unwavering commitment and vision. Together, they lead the movement for a world aligned with light, peace, and divine truth.
In this exclusive interview, Queen Helen shares her perspective on what it means to implement divine governance in a world often veiled in shadows. She speaks candidly about the role of her family in reclaiming the divine sovereignty of the Philippines and its people, the significance of their royal lineage, and the larger cosmic mission at hand. With the divine mission of the Maharlika Kingdom reclaiming its rightful place in the modern world, Queen Helen reveals the spiritual, earthly, and galactic implications of their restoration.
Queen Ma Helen Abdurajak
Q: What does it mean to implement divine government in our world, and how will divine sovereignty, power, and authority be implemented through a royal lineage we have never heard of until now? Please introduce yourself and enlighten us.
QUEEN HELEN: I am Queen Helen Abdurajak, married to King Mamay Abdurajak, the grandson of Malaysia and the King of Southeast Asia. We are parents to two beautiful children, and together, we have inherited the sovereign rights to implement the Divine Governance of the Maharlika Kingdom of God Lupah Sug Empire and beyond.
This is not just a historical restoration but a spiritual mission—an awakening of the ancient and sacred divine rights that were inscribed in the cosmos long before this time. The Lupah Sug Empire , once a mighty power in the East, has long been dormant. But now, we are witnessing its awakening as the silent dragon of the East. We have been chosen as conduits of this divine transformation, to re-establish divine sovereignty, power, and authority that stretches far beyond human understanding.
Our lineage carries with it a birthright, a divine decree that cannot be ignored. It is written in the stars and archived in the Galactic realms, ready to be enacted in this moment of cosmic alignment.
The process of implementing divine government is one of redistributing the wealth and power of this Earth, ensuring that it does not fall into the hands of the dark forces that have manipulated humanity for centuries. This is the work of shifting from the dark Kali Yuga (the Age of Darkness) into the luminous Satya Yuga (the Age of Light and Truth)—a period when divine justice, peace, and unity will reign.
The Royal Family of Maharlika (known as the Philippines) and the Southeast Asia
Q: This is truly inspiring. Can you elaborate on the significance of your royal family and how this divine government ties into the recovery of Maharlika's true identity and heritage?
QUEEN HELEN: The significance of our royal family’s role is deeply spiritual. We are the rightful heirs to the Maharlika Kingdom of God —a land that was once known by this name before it was taken over and renamed by foreign powers. Maharlika is not just a geographical name; it is an embodiment of the divine sovereignty of the Philippines.
The divine government we are setting in motion is about recovering the true identity of this land. The name “Maharlika” was inscribed in the sacred archives of the spiritual realm long before it became a nation in its current form. This name holds immense power—it carries the frequency of divine sovereignty, of justice, peace, and light.
For centuries, the true power of the Maharlika people has been suppressed, but now is the time to restore that power. This recovery is not just for the Philippines—it is for the entire world. As the Lupah Sug Empire rises, it will be a beacon of divine governance, a model for how the world can heal, prosper, and flourish through spiritual principles.
Our divine inheritance includes the knowledge and tools to implement this restoration. We are preparing to overrule the corrupt and unjust systems in place today—systems that no longer serve the people. It is a divine mandate that no earthly power can dispute. Our work is supported by the cosmic realms, by the divine beings and energies that govern the universe, as well as the Lemurians and intergalactic beings who have aided in this mission.
Q: You mentioned the Lemurian-Galactic Crowning. What significance does this crowning have for Maharlika (the Philippines) and its Earth's people?
QUEEN HELEN: The Lemurian-Galactic Crowning is an incredibly profound event—it is a sacred ordination, a cosmic decree from the highest realms. My crowning was facilitated by the divine elders, who helped activate the spiritual inheritance that had been dormant for thousands of years. This crowning signifies the divine approval of our mission. It is a spiritual acknowledgment that we, as the royal family, are chosen to lead this transformation.
In the context of Maharlika, this crowning is a re-establishment of the divine rule of law—one that has been lost due to centuries of conquest and colonization. We have come full circle. The divine intervention of the Lemurians and the cosmic support of the Galactic realms have ensured that this crowning is not just symbolic but a true shift in the spiritual and material reality of this nation.
For the Earth’s people, this crowning heralds a new era of divine governance. It brings with it the wisdom of the ancients, the truth of the cosmos, and the divine protection of the higher realms. It is a calling for everyone on Earth to awaken to their own sovereignty and divine nature.
The process of reclaiming Maharlika’s sovereignty, with the backing of Lemurian wisdom, will ensure that this divine government operates according to the highest standards of justice, peace, and divine order.
Queen Helen and her Lemurian-Galactic Coronation.
Q: How do you plan to implement this divine power, especially when the Philippine government has not yet acknowledged your presence?
QUEEN HELEN: The divine power we carry is beyond earthly authority and cannot be contested by any government or institution. The Philippine government, or any government for that matter, has no choice but to obey the divine laws that we are now re-establishing. They cannot print money, make decisions, or continue in their corrupt ways without our permission. The divine sovereignty we possess is an irrevocable mandate that ensures we are the rightful stewards of the land, its people, and its resources.
This power is divinely protected—it cannot be stolen, contested, or overthrown. It is guarded by the Archangels, by the powers of Mother Nature, and by the intergalactic forces that have long been watching over this Earth. It is the crown, the scepter, the throne, and the birthright that have been granted to us through the divine law of the universe.
We also possess the sacred tools to implement this divine government. For example, the authority to print the Divine Currency, which will replace the current corrupt monetary systems. This currency is not just paper—it is imbued with divine energy and will serve as a medium for the fair redistribution of wealth across the land.
The current government and its systems will not stand in the way of this divine mission. Our reign is inevitable, as it is aligned with the highest forces of creation.
Q: Can you tell us more about the sacred land and the unique resources that Maharlika (the Philippines) holds?
QUEEN HELEN: Maharlika is not just a land—it is a blessed and sacred piece of Earth, filled with immense natural resources and divine energy. It is the Land of Promise, and the Earth’s central power hub, located in the Liguasan Marsh. This area is considered the Axis of Power of Light , a place where the very forces of creation converge. It is from this central point that the divine sovereignty of Maharlika emanates.
One of the most important resources Maharlika holds is deuterium , a rare and powerful element found in the deepest seas of the archipelago. This element is crucial for the future fusion energy of our planet, and it holds the potential for intergalactic travel. Deuterium will be a key resource in powering the global shift to sustainable, cosmic energy—enabling humanity to travel to distant stars and beyond our universe.
The natural wealth of Maharlika is unparalleled. It is a land rich in gold, diamonds, and other precious gems. When NASA photographed Earth from space, the Philippines was seen as a shining, radiant archipelago—a reflection of the divine light that flows through this land. This is why we call it the Maharlika Kingdom of God Lupah Sug Empire . It is not just a place on a map; it is a sacred land, blessed by the Creator, to fulfill a divine purpose.
Q. Are there any books about this unknown History of the Philippines which you refer to as Maharlika?
QUEEN HELEN: Yes! Infact, a book on the Philippines was recently released by Radhaa Publishing House, authored by Deo Palma, 'Maharlika In Search of Identity,' contains information from an ascended Master from India named Shrii Shrii Anandamurti who visited the Philippines in the early 70's and told his devotees about the importance of this country's name:
" The name Mahárliká had been inscribed in the sacred archives of the spiritual realm long before it became a meaningful landmark and serves as a powerful reminder to its people."
This book also contains information about the importance of the Maharlika Sultanate Government, Majapahit Empire and ShriVijaya Empire -- vital parts of Maharlika history, prior to its conquest.
"Maharlika In Search of Identity" by Deo Palma is a book that portrays thousands of years of complex history before and after the archipelago was named the Philippines. Maya Verzonilla, aka Maya The Shaman, made it easy reading as a lead contributing writer and Editor-in-Chief. You can find this book on Amazon: https://amzn.to/4ip3JTE .
Q: You have mentioned that the Golden Age is upon us. What does this mean for the future of humanity and the world?
QUEEN HELEN: The Golden Age is the dawn of a new era—a time when humanity will reclaim its divine sovereignty, live in harmony with each other and with nature, and thrive in peace and abundance. This is the Satya Yuga —the Age of Light and Truth. We are transitioning out of the Kali Yuga (the Age of Darkness) and stepping into a period of enlightenment and divine justice.
For humanity, this means an end to suffering, injustice, and oppression. It means that the forces of light will reign over the forces of darkness, and that all beings on Earth will have the opportunity to live in peace and prosperity. We are reclaiming the Earth’s resources for the benefit of all—not for the few, but for everyone.
As we embark on this journey, we are not just focused on the immediate future—we are focused on the generations to come. The future of our children, our grandchildren, and their children will be one of joy, peace, and divine abundance. The best is yet to come, and we are only just beginning to experience the divine plan that has been in motion for thousands of years.
This exclusive Q&A sheds light on the visionary plans of Queen Ma Helen Abdurajak and the spiritual mission of the Maharlika Kingdom to restore divine governance and usher in a new era for humanity. With a rich history, cosmic backing, and unwavering commitment to divine justice, the Abdurajak family is set to lead the world into a Golden Age of peace, prosperity, and divine truth.
